common.announcement: Fresh groceries from growers we trust, delivered to your door.

footer.blurb: Honest groceries from growers and bakers we have met, packed fresh and brought to your door.

hero.title: Good food, quietly sourced
hero.body: Seasonal produce, honest bread and pantry staples from growers and bakers we know by name, delivered to your door.
hero.imageAlt: A wooden table with seasonal vegetables and fresh bread

editorial.title: A morning at the bakery
editorial.body: Before the shutters go up, the ovens have been running for hours. We spent a morning with the baker who makes our sourdough, and learned why slow dough tastes better.
editorial.imageAlt: Loaves of sourdough cooling on a wooden rack

contact.body: Allergies, substitutions or a delivery that did not go to plan: we read every message and reply within a working day.
